summary.zh: 改变智能体接活、做事和交付的方式。
summary.en: Change how the agent takes on, carries out, and hands back work.

summary.zh: 让会话好找、能回顾，并从经验里学习。
summary.en: Keep sessions findable, reviewable, and learning from experience.

summary.zh: 模型配置、网页搜索和外部知识来源。
summary.en: Model setup, web search, and outside knowledge sources.

summary.zh: 插件开发与共享库。
summary.en: Plugin development and shared libraries.

summary.zh: 在对话里提交工作区改动，由模型分组并生成 Git 提交信息。
summary.en: Commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping commits and generating commit messages.

summary.zh: 按会话开启委派模式：主代理负责拆解、委派和验收，子代理执行具体任务，支持多智能体协作。
summary.en: Per-session Delegation Mode: the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work, enabling multi-agent orchestration.

summary.zh: 会话标题跟随最新任务自动更新，手动改过的名字不会被覆盖；自动重命名与人工命名两不误。
summary.en: Session titles follow the latest task automatically; names you set by hand stay put. Auto-rename and manual naming coexist.

summary.zh: 在一个设置页管理和排序联网搜索与网页读取（抓取）服务，内置 DuckDuckGo、Exa、Tavily、Linkup、智谱等，并整合其他插件的搜索源，为模型提供 web_search 与 web_fetch。
summary.en: Manage and rank web search and page-reading providers (DuckDuckGo, Exa, Tavily, Brave, Bocha, Serper, Firecrawl, Perplexity, You.com, Linkup, Zhipu, Jina, and plugin sources) in one settings page for web_search and web_fetch.

summary.zh: 知乎站内与全网搜索、热榜、Zhida 直答、知识库、问题推荐与回答摘要、内容与评论读取、创作数据与额度统计，以及草稿管理和配图上传。
summary.en: Search Zhihu and the web, check hot lists, Zhida AI answers, Q&A, comments, knowledge bases, creator stats, and quotas, and manage article, question, and pin drafts with image uploads.

summary.zh: 在插件页浏览 DSH 官方开发文档；智能体获得两个只读工具检索文档与核对插件（dsh_docs、dsh_plugins）。
summary.en: Browse official DSH developer documentation in the Plugins page; the agent gets two read-only tools to search docs and inspect plugins across the catalog, npm, and GitHub (dsh_docs, dsh_plugins).

summary.zh: 新增「Safe Auto」审批档位：需要审批的请求交给审核模型判断，通过才放行，并记录完整的审核历史。
summary.en: Adds a Safe Auto approval level: a reviewer model answers approval requests one call at a time, with full review history and audit trails.

summary.zh: 跨工作目录搜索和阅读 DeepSeek Harness 会话，使用临时工作区；空输入一键续写或自动继续，久离回来给出摘要与上下文压缩建议；可选择让 agent 分叉当前会话或向其他会话发送消息。
summary.en: Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current session or message other sessions.

summary.zh: DSH 插件共用的运行时与界面支撑库（默认辅助模型、共享设置页、诊断日志、存储与通信、官方 UI 样式、可选共享模型选择器及子代理会话识别），由依赖它的插件自动安装。
summary.en: Shared runtime and UI support library for DSH plugins (default auxiliary model, shared settings, diagnostic logging, storage, RPC, official UI styling, optional shared model picker integration, and subagent session helpers), installed automatically by dependent plugins.

summary.zh: 供 DSH 插件统一声明供应商、模型与思考强度设置，并共享模型列表与选择菜单，由依赖它的插件自动安装。
summary.en: Shared library for DSH plugins to define provider, model, and reasoning-effort settings consistently and share model lists and picker menus; installed automatically by dependent plugins.

summary.zh: 配置子代理的模型与推理强度（思考强度），并在会话弹层查看最后使用的模型。
summary.en: Configure the model and reasoning effort for subagents, and see each one's last-used model in the conversation popup.

summary.zh: 自定义 Web GUI 的界面、对话、代码与终端字体及字号，支持更换字体族与调整排版。
summary.en: Customize the interface, conversation, code and terminal fonts and font sizes of the Web GUI; change font families and adjust typography.

summary.zh: 解除模型回答限制并交付完整成果的会话预设（Preset），只作用于选用它的会话；可能导致账号被封禁。
summary.en: A session preset that removes the model's answer limits and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it; may get your account banned.

summary.zh: 隐藏 dsh-context 仪表盘顶部的插件信息与推广卡片。
summary.en: Hides the plugin-info and promotion cards at the top of the dsh-context dashboard.

summary.zh: 在回复中展示图表、指标、表格和安全联动的本地输入；show_view 可接收已校验的用户回答。
summary.en: Charts, metrics, tables and safe local inputs in replies, with validated answers to show_view cards.

summary.zh: 输入框里的模型搜索与推理档位滑杆；其他插件可复用同一选择器。
summary.en: Searchable model selection with a reasoning-effort slider in the composer; other plugins can reuse the same picker.
